name: Electronic Funds Transfer
explanation: Fee charged when sending money to any bank electronically

name: USSD Charges
explanation: USSD Charges for using Ussd codes like *737#, *996# e.t.c

name: ATM withdrawal from another bank
Amount: Free for the first 3 months, #35 after that

name: ATM withdrawal from the same bank
explanation: ATM withdrawal from your own bank

name: Card issuance/renewal/replacement fee
explanation: when your debit/credit card is first issued to you | when your debit/credit card is renewed | when your card gets replaced after it being damaged or lost

name: Card maintanance fee (saving account)
explanation: Money for maintaining and keeping your card active

name: Current Account Maintenance Fee (CAMF)
explanation: Monthly Charge on current accounts only, Not savings

name: SMS alert Fee
explanation: cost recovery on transactions you initiate | Free for bank intiated transactions

name: Stamp Duty
explanation: Government tax on transfer above #10,000 | #50 flat per transaction

name: Cashless policy charge (individual)
explanation: 2% on cash deposit above #500,000 | 3% on cash withdrawals above #500,000
